title: As A Result Of Breaking An Otome Game, The Villainess Young Lady Becomes A Cheat!
description: Charlotte, who reincarnated as a villain girl in an otome game, started to avoid the death flag. The goal is to spread the sake that I loved in this world! However, the juice and holy water that I made for trial were all nonstandard… As A Result Of Breaking An Otome Game, The Villainess Young Lady Becomes A Cheat!,Because of Her Love for Sake, the Otome Game Setting Was Broken and the Villainous Noblewoman Became the Noblewoman With Cheats, お酒のために乙女ゲー設定をぶち壊した結果、悪役令嬢がチート令嬢になりました
